policies.corkage: We charge a corkage fee for wine brought in — please ask your waiter for tonight's rate.
policies.children: Children are very welcome — we have a kids' menu and high chairs available.
policies.dress: The dress code is smart casual.
policies.parking: Secure parking is available adjacent to the restaurant.
policies.wifi: Yes — complimentary guest Wi‑Fi is available. Ask your waiter for the password.
policies.smoking: Smoking is permitted in the designated outdoor area only.
policies.reservations: We accept reservations and walk-ins. You can book a table through the app or ask your waiter.

faqs.a: Yes, we accept reservations — book through the app or ask your waiter.
Some dishes can be prepared to preference — please ask your waiter and we'll confirm with the kitchen.

faqs.q: do you cater for large groups
faqs.a: Yes, we cater for groups and functions — speak to your waiter or the manager to arrange it.
